खेद m. (-दः)
 1. Sorrow, affliction, distress. Lassitude, depression.
 3.

. Proverty.
 E. खिद् to be distressed, affix घञ्.

खेदान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, pained.
 E. खेद, and अन्वित having.

खेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Annoyed, harassed.
 2. Afflicted, distressed,
pained.
 E. खिद् to give pain, क्त aff.

खेदिनी f. (-नी)
 1. A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia:) see असनपर्णी.
 2. A
creeper, a creeping plant.
 E. खिद् to be distressed, affixes णिनि and
ङीष्.
